patch_description:
This design models outgoing and incoming links as portfolios of routing opportunities. A deterministic fractional network estimates destination coverage over several hops. A second-order expansion of a logarithmic coverage objective then rewards complementary neighbors and penalizes redundant ones.

Sparse two-link completion rewards provide topology-dependent routing information, while the coverage model supplies longer-range information missing from direct-demand and two-hop-only surrogates. Route selection accounts for estimated fractional transit load. Coupling counts remain O(n³), and degree penalties are left entirely to the evaluator.
